allow_large: A release bump changes the version in every file that records it
done_when: The version is 1.2.38, generated files are synced, forge.toml pins this repo to v1.2.38, and the tests pass

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - a reviewer checks the release evidence before merge.
The proof list maps the repository pin and generated files, but omits explicit entries for the release version and the passing-tests clauses of Done-when. This test already checks the version, and the pull-request tests check is configured in .github/workflows/forge.yml. Map those checks to the missing clauses; a pending CI result need not be treated as a failure.
